title.description: Short name of the concept, as the course names it

definition.description: Correct, self-contained definition or statement; LaTeX in $...$ for math

slide.description: 1-based page/slide number where it is taught

evidence.description: Short verbatim quote copied from that slide's text that supports the concept; empty if the content is only in an image or equation

useWhen.description: Cues in a problem that signal this concept or method applies; empty for plain terms

confusedWith.description: Titles of look-alike concepts a student might mix up with this one

gapFill.description: true if any part of the definition comes from outside the material
